articles.title: Captive Crocodiles Don't Try to Go Home — But Wild Ones Do
articles.summary: A new study tracked five saltwater crocodiles in Bangladesh. Three raised in captivity settled into new homes without trying to return. But a wild crocodile named Jongra swam over 30 kilometers in one day, heading straight back.

articles.title: Original Star Wars Hits IMAX for Its 50th Anniversary in 2027
articles.summary: The original Star Wars is coming to IMAX for the first time in 2027, celebrating its 50th anniversary. A restored version will screen on Feb. 19, and a new film, Star Wars: Starfighter, arrives May 28.

articles.title: Chemistry Textbooks Have Been Teaching This Wrong for Nearly a Century
articles.summary: A new study says the inductive effect, a core chemistry concept, doesn't travel through 3-4 bonds as textbooks claim. It stops after one bond. Two UK exam boards are already reviewing their teaching.
